## 2. Required columns and per-role rules

Core states required columns inside the role text; it is copied unchanged.

- `bounds`: exactly one ef4.interval.bounds fact: effective_start_ns = S, effective_end_ns = E, S < E; required by every output
- `quotes`: full normalized bid/ask state or snapshot per admitted row (never a delta); bid, ask int64 coefficients at the price scale (null or nonpositive is an invalid state); bid_size, ask_size int64 shares >= 0 or null; event_ns in [S, E) and < C; ordered by (event_ns, order_key); batch metadata sampling trade_snapshot or continuous; None is an absent delivery; the declared IntervalCoverage (complete or incomplete) travels with the batch

## 3. Reference fact kinds and schemas

- **ef4.interval.bounds**:
  - **instrument_id**: target entity
  - **session_id**: the session
  - **reference_id**: x1:B(interval_id)
  - **effective_start_ns**: S, the interval start and the VWAP anchor (utc_ns)
  - **effective_end_ns**: E, the exclusive interval end (utc_ns), > start
  - **text**: equals batch source.snapshot_id
  - **price**: null
  - **factor_num/factor_den**: null
  - **known_at_ns**: original knowledge of the interval and anchor, nullable
- **ef4.window.edge**:
  - **instrument_id**: target entity
  - **session_id**: the session
  - **reference_id**: x1:B(grid_version#edge_index), unique
  - **effective_start_ns**: absolute edge time (utc_ns), strictly increasing
  - **effective_end_ns**: null
  - **text**: grid_version
  - **known_at_ns**: nullable
- **ef4.series.proof**:
  - **instrument_id**: target entity
  - **session_id**: the session
  - **reference_id**: x1:B(series_id)
  - **effective_start_ns**: S
  - **effective_end_ns**: E
  - **text**: equals config series_policy_id (opaque, non-empty; names the supplied series preparation and its eligibility policy)
  - **price**: null
  - **factor_num/factor_den**: null
  - **known_at_ns**: original knowledge of the series, nullable
- **note**: require_compatible_inputs applies among market roles (quotes, trades, bars); REFERENCE roles with price_unit None are not compared. Rows inside one (instrument, session) group are ordered by (effective_start_ns, reference_id). price, factor_num and factor_den are null for every EF4-H fact, so no price unit is needed on a REFERENCE batch. The proof fact does not carry the series values: it binds identity, and unit, basis, grid and anchor are checked against the bars batch and the other facts.

The schemas are listed for the whole core contract file, that is for all of its producers.

## 5. Coverage, adjustment, scale, known_at and mode rules

- **mode_rule**: known_at and reconstruction availability give identical results with original known_at; batch and full replay only; update, restore and merge unsupported
- **interval_kind_rule**: ef4.interval.bounds is the shared declared-interval kind for both EF4-H producers (self-contained definition in reference_fact_schemas); a duplicate (instrument, session, reference_id) is DUPLICATE and two bounds facts with different reference ids are INCONSISTENT_IDENTITY.
- **layer_responsibilities**:
  - **library**: admission of the supplied facts, interval and anchor handling, observation classification, microprice, maxima, change and path arithmetic, extrema and slopes, quality, evidence and every library refusal; pure and deterministic with exact rational intermediates and one final rounding; one shared interval/knowledge admission for both producers; no coupling of output readiness
  - **io_ef4**: maps ordered quote and trade rows, bar windows, grid edges, interval bounds and proof facts exactly as supplied with original known_at and declared coverage; never sorts, fills, imputes, dedupes, converts scale or currency, selects a correction version, derives windows from trades, or computes any statistic; maps results unchanged
  - **worker_ef4**: routes selected outputs, shares one admitted interval or prepared series across outputs and configs, keeps independent readiness, executes one config per complete result, binds inputs and the config digest and persists the library result unchanged; direct, adapter, worker and stored results identical including refusal class

## 6. Input-stage refusals

- **refusal_precedence**:
  - **rule**: a call is refused by the first applicable tier; within the shared validator tier the first offending row of the first offending batch in role order raises; within the library tier the order below applies; assessment (status, reasons) happens only when nothing is refused
  - **tiers**:
    - T1 config: C.version (INCOMPATIBLE_VERSION), C.feature (UNKNOWN_FEATURE), C.capability (UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY), C.params (INVALID_CONFIG)
    - T2 shared batch construction: K.cell_type (INVALID_SCHEMA), K.overflow (OVERFLOW), K.no_unit (INVALID_UNIT), K.no_sampling (UNSUPPORTED_SAMPLING)
    - T3 shared validate_batch per batch in role order (bounds, grid, proof, quotes/trades/bars): duplicate identity or tie key (DUPLICATE) before ordering (INVALID_ORDER) before interval, cutoff and bounds (BOUNDS) before schema rules (INVALID_SCHEMA), negative quantity last (BOUNDS)
    - T4 library: L.batch_kind, L.fact_kind (INVALID_SCHEMA); L.scale (INVALID_UNIT); L.basis (UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT); L.sampling_mismatch, L.change_on_snapshot (UNSUPPORTED_SAMPLING); L.bounds_count, L.bounds_text, L.row_identity, L.source_roles, L.proof_count, L.proof_text, L.grid_text, L.bar_align (INCONSISTENT_IDENTITY); L.row_before_start, L.row_at_or_after_end, L.grid_first_edge, L.grid_last_edge, L.grid_equal_edges, L.bar_end_after_cutoff (BOUNDS); L.bar_notional_positive (INVALID_SCHEMA)
  - **dependencies**: L.sampling_mismatch is evaluated only when the config sampling is valid; L.grid_text and L.proof_text only when the config value is valid; L.bar_align only on a sound grid (strictly increasing, first edge = S, last edge = E, correct kind and text). Each refusal fixture is a single-fault construction: its recipe fires exactly the one named rule, which the harness verifies by applying the recipe to the base fixture.
- **refusal_model**: harness model built from a base fixture: config{params,outputs,capability,price_scale,basis}, C, bounds[], grid[], proof[] (facts: instrument, session, reference_id, kind, start, end, text, known_at), quotes|trades|bars {kind, sampling, scale, basis, unit, rows[]} with placeholder instrument I, session S0, snapshot 'snap', reference ids x1:B(i1), x1:B(G#n), x1:B(s1), grid text G and series policy P. Mutation ops: set, del_key, insert, delete, dup, swap on dotted paths (list indices are integers). Placeholders never appear as contract values.
- **shared_validator_split**:
  - **shared validator (validation.py validate_batch)**:
    - trade: duplicate event_id or (event_ns, order_key) DUPLICATE, unordered INVALID_ORDER, event at or after the market cutoff BOUNDS, an eligible trade with null or nonpositive price or size INVALID_SCHEMA
    - quote: the same identity, order and cutoff rules; a null or nonpositive side is a counted invalid state, never a refusal; negative size BOUNDS
    - bar: start >= end BOUNDS, duplicate (start, end) DUPLICATE, overlap INVALID_ORDER, end after the market cutoff BOUNDS; volume 0 requires null OHLC and zero or absent notional else INVALID_SCHEMA; volume > 0 with OHLC columns requires positive nonnull coherent OHLC and a notional within [low*volume, high*volume] else INVALID_SCHEMA; negative quantity BOUNDS
    - reference: duplicate reference identity DUPLICATE, unordered (start, reference_id) INVALID_ORDER, start >= end BOUNDS
  - **library (this contract)**:
    - interval membership of rows (before S, at or after E) BOUNDS; bar source E > C BOUNDS
    - positive notional on positive volume when no OHLC columns are delivered (INVALID_SCHEMA)
    - all identity, grid, proof, role, sampling, unit, basis and config checks
